Priya Desai: Noticing an odd uptick in 'at-risk' flags for our Scale cohort this morning. Looks correlated with onboarding trigger change deployed yesterday.
Miguel Torres: Which trigger? I pushed an update to the onboarding playbook to reduce noise by removing auto-advance on partial_profile.
Priya Desai: That one. A chunk of accounts that had only partial_profile were previously getting "initial_engaged" trigger, boosting their health. Now they're not.
Zoe (CS Ops): Ah, we scoped partial_profile out because product reported high false positives. But we didn't add a compensating rule in the health mapping.
Miguel Torres: Hmm. Options: 1) revert the playbook change, 2) backfill the missing triggers for affected accounts, 3) update health mapping to add a lower-weight signal for partial_profile.
Priya Desai: Prefer avoid revert. We need to preserve the product fix. Can we do a targeted backfill + short-term mapping patch?
Miguel Torres: Yes. I'll craft a backfill that re-emits "initial_engaged" only for accounts where partial_profile + at least one other product_event exists within 7 days. Keeps noise down.
Zoe (CS Ops): I'll define acceptance criteria: net at-risk count should not increase >1% per cohort; also include a CSM note on any account modified.
infra-bot: Playbook change deployed: onboarding-v2 @ miguel (deploy id dpl-20260315-9)
Priya Desai: Miguel, can you paste the SQL you plan to run for the backfill so CS Ops can review?
Miguel Torres: Sure:
```
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT a.account_id
  FROM onboarding_events a
  WHERE a.event_type = 'partial_profile'
    AND a.event_time >= '2026-03-01'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM product_events p
      WHERE p.account_id = a.account_id
        AND p.event_time BETWEEN a.event_time - INTERVAL '7 days' AND a.event_time + INTERVAL '7 days'
        AND p.event_type <> 'partial_profile'
    )
)
SELECT account_id FROM candidates;
```
Miguel Torres: Backfill runner will emit idempotent triggers: trigger_id = sha256(account_id || '-engage-backfill-202603') and rate-limit 15/s.
Zoe (CS Ops): Add CSM note template and include a tag so inbox shows these are automated corrections. Also prepare a short broadcast to affected CSMs.
Priya Desai: Let's also add a small-weight mapping: partial_profile_cohorted = +2 only when co-occurring with any product_event within 7d; otherwise 0. A/B on 10% of new signups for 14 days.
infra-bot: Created branch: cs/score-partial-profile-weighting. PR expected.
Miguel Torres: Opening PR now. Includes backfill runner, idempotency, and a CI check that ensures playbook->score mapping can't drop total "on_track" by more than 2% in historical sim.
Zoe (CS Ops): Acceptance checklist: 1) Staging run shows recoveries consistent with projection, 2) CSM notes attached, 3) Broadcast drafted, 4) scorable metrics logged to observability for 14 days.
Priya Desai: Timeline: staging backfill tonight, prod late window tomorrow. Miguel, please tag me when you schedule prod.
Miguel Torres: Scheduled prod backfill for 2026-03-16T21:00Z. I'll ping once complete.
playbook-bot: Backfill job queued -> staging (run id: backfill-20260315-22).
Miguel Torres: Staging stats: scanned 240 accounts, emitted 198 triggers, 42 skipped.
Zoe (CS Ops): Staging health counts pre/after: green 820 -> 858, yellow 210 -> 176, red 30 -> 34. Looks within thresholds.
Priya Desai: Good. Proceed to prod as scheduled. Remember the idempotency key and throttle.
Miguel Torres: Kicked off prod run at 2026-03-16T21:00Z. Run id backfill-20260316-01.
playbook-bot: Prod backfill completed: processed 238 accounts, emitted 195 triggers, 43 skipped.
Zoe (CS Ops): Post-prod health delta: green +34, yellow -28, red -6. All within acceptance. Broadcast to CSMs sent.
Priya Desai: Thanks team. Follow-up: Miguel please add a pre-merge checklist item for any playbook change that might affect scoring and include a simple simulation summary.
Miguel Torres: Will do. PR merged: cs/score-partial-profile-weighting (#412).
Zoe (CS Ops): Closing loop: updated playbook docs and created a retrofit test that runs a 90-day historical sim on staging before deploys that touch onboarding triggers.
Priya Desai: Love it. Closing thread.
